audit_1_config_and_input_lineage.details: Feature store 1.6.0 immutable checksum verified (ab1a34a83857e78e...); Config SHA matched.

audit_2_global_k_selection.details: Global K=2 strictly frozen via median silhouette on dev window without lookahead.

audit_3_zero_leakage.details: Strict separation between Dev (60 snapshots) and Holdout (24 snapshots); decision timestamp strictly precedes holdout.

audit_4_train_holdout_boundary.details: Continuous 84 snapshots with zero gaps; strict separation between 60 dev and 24 holdout snapshots.

audit_5_universe_eligibility.details: Per-snapshot eligibility enforced; all snapshots have n_eligible >= 100 (lowest snapshot: 503 stocks).

audit_6_single_model_holdout.details: Only winning method (KMeans_Baseline, K=2) evaluated on holdout; Ward and PCA comparator strictly excluded.

audit_7_no_portfolio_metrics.details: Zero portfolio return/Sharpe used in clustering decisions; selection strictly geometric and statistical.

audit_8_reproducibility.details: Deterministic rerun matches 100% with zero tolerance across bounded fixtures and unit tests.
